footnotes_as_printed: not captured (none printed); column group headings: 'Analysis Mole Fraction, Dry Basis' (HC Vapor ethane, ethylene; Water in HC vapor x 10^3) and 'Analysis Mole Fraction, Wet Basis' (HC in Water x 10^3: ethane, ethylene, total)
pressure_note: column headed 'Pressure, P.S.I.A.' (absolute); treated as total pressure of the two-phase cell (p.21 phase-rule statement: pressure, temperature and vapor composition specified; p.23 hydrocarbon partial pressure = dry-basis vapor fraction x P)

value.what: water mole fraction in the ethane-ethylene vapor ('Mole fraction water in vapor')

value2.col: HC in water wet basis 10^3 x Ethane
value2.what: ethane mole fraction in the water-rich liquid, wet basis (water included in the total)

value3.col: HC in water wet basis 10^3 x Ethylene
value3.what: ethylene mole fraction in the water-rich liquid, wet basis

composition.other_species: pure water (distilled, gas-free); no salt. Gas phase is a binary ethane-ethylene mixture, dry-basis composition in the columns HC vapor dry basis Ethane/Ethylene

extra_unmapped: HC vapor dry basis Ethane (vapor-phase mole fraction on a water-free basis; an independent variable set by the experimenters)
HC in water wet basis 10^3 x Total (sum of ethane and ethylene in water, measured as total hydrocarbon)
conversion_needs: three-phase-free two-phase region, hydrocarbon vapor is supercritical at 100 F and above for the ethane-rich mixtures near the ethane critical point: no liquid hydrocarbon phase reported
notes: Rows with 'No liquid sample taken' have the three water-phase cells empty. Printed '-0-' (zero) for the absent component in the two pure-gas runs is written 0. Pure-gas rows (rows 7 and 8: pure ethane, pure ethylene) are binary data. Dry-basis fractions in data row 102 do not sum to 1 (see paper.json). Page 22 = rows 0-70 and page 23 = rows 71-115 (0-based data rows). No standard-conditions definition is needed (no gas volumes).
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: CSV rows 7 and 8 are the pure-gas runs (pure ethane 99.9 F, 539.6 psia; pure ethylene 100.1 F, 1017.2 psia), i.e. binary ethane-water and ethylene-water points; gas set per row from the dry-basis ethane column. Liquid-phase columns of some rows do not satisfy ethane + ethylene = total as printed (e.g. 219.8 F, 503.9 psia: 0.9797 + 0.9790 vs 1.077; 219.9 F, 4009.7 psia: 0.5425 + 2.4124 vs 1.955); kept as printed, these columns are not used.
